title: Country-related cooperation programme with Colombia (COLFUTURO - Fundación para el Futuro de Colombia)
summary: Grants for very well qualified Colombian graduates holding a master's degree to complete a doctoral degree in Germany.

residence.notes: Must be living in Colombia and applying from there for study in Germany.

mandatory.text: Accomplished a master (or equivalent) degree at the time of application

funding.description: Intensive German course in Germany (up to 6 months including accommodation and cost of living); costs of outward and return travel; monthly scholarship payments up to the maximum amount determined by COLFUTURO; medical, nursing care, accident and personal liability insurance; cost of German language course for accompanying spouse if applicable; contribution towards costs of printing thesis; refund of TestDaF or DSH exam; one-year research and study allowance. COLFUTURO contribution is a scholarship credit paid back in full or part.
funding.duration: Approx. 3-4 years for doctoral studies; grants awarded for one year with required applications for further funding/extension.

application_rounds.notes: Dates not specified on the page.
